summary_en: When carrier RAN teams plan capacity on existing spectrum and base stations, they traditionally
  rely on drive tests, parameter tuning and manual experience to squeeze out headroom; Aglocell's AI software
  ingests RAN operating data and proposes optimization actions, yielding a 4.1% capacity gain in trials.

  sign-off remain unverified.

  rather than per-seat software; the precondition is access to live network data and carrier acceptance
  criteria.
